verdict.rationale: Calendly's official MCP server turns natural-language commands such as "Book a 30-minute meeting with Sam next Tuesday" into structured Calendly API calls, and it exposes a documented tool list that includes write actions like creating event types. Calendly also ships Callie, a first-party AI assistant that schedules over email and offers an interactive chat, so users can operate the product conversationally in more than one way. Missing for 10: no independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language operation works reliably, and Callie is still labeled Beta, which leaves the depth of its in-product chat unproven.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: It translates natural-language commands (e.g., "Book a 30-minute meeting with Sam next Tuesday") into structured Calendly API calls with no need to implement raw REST requests.
